exposure.note: Canon, rhubarb (rawand), entry canon.b2.h0693, joints section: 'al-Khuzi said: the dose is two dirhams in a mixed syrup', for falls, blows and muscle tears. The Canon attributes this dose to al-Khuzi, an earlier authority, not to Ibn Sina himself. Identification of medieval rawand is uncertain (Rheum palmatum / R. officinale assumed, as in the EMA monograph; R. ribes also possible). Content range is total hydroxyanthracene derivatives expressed as rhein (3-12 percent of the dried root, EMA/HMPC/113701/2019); 60-80 percent are glycosides and only small amounts are free aglycones, so modelling the whole amount as rhein overestimates immediate free rhein exposure and the model has no colonic activation step. Machine translation.
